title: 基于道义策略的自主AI系统运行时治理
summary: 提出AgenticRei框架，利用基于OWL的道义策略语言和外部高性能逻辑引擎，在运行时对LLM驱动的自主AI系统进行治理，涵盖许可/禁止、义务、豁免、策略冲突解决等企业治理需求，弥补了XACML等现有策略引擎的不足。
summary_en: Proposes AgenticRei, a framework using a deontic policy language based on OWL and an external high-performance logic engine for runtime governance of LLM-driven autonomous AI systems, covering permissions, prohibitions, obligations, dispensations, and conflict resolution, addressing gaps in current policy engines like XACML.
